service.description: The weeks of time on SUPP, dated from the week the data is loaded (Monday weeks, the default policy), by the real paths (mantle.work.TimeServices.store#TimeEntry, mantle.work.TimesheetServices submit#, approve#, return#Timesheet and start#Timer), each as its user at a time in the past, so the audit and the notices are theirs: - Joe Developer, two weeks back: 40 hours on SUPP-1 and SUPP-2, submitted the next Monday and approved by John Doe; - Joe Developer, last week: 38 hours (Friday short), submitted this Monday and waiting for John Doe (its approval notice is marked decided in the tray so the M2 demo's one approval stays the tray's; Timesheets' To approve lists it); - Bob Developer, last week: 32 hours, Friday empty, submitted and returned by John Doe with the reason; - this week before today: Joe's time on SUPP-1 and SUPP-2 and John Doe's on SUPP-3 (on a Monday, John Doe's half hour that morning instead); John Doe's timer running on SUPP-1 since 47 minutes before the load. Each part on its own: one that fails is logged and the rest go on. Loading again adds nothing when Joe's week two weeks back already has time.
